input_read: independent read-only tool output of the complete targeted diff
findings: The successor saves the unchanged Main am.pinned_address and invokes it for the active exact URL only after a POST has been reserved and retained.

During original hostname resolution the guard admits only openrouter.ai:443 SOCK_STREAM; it records a pinned IP only after the original resolver succeeds and additionally rejects non-global or IPv4-mapped results.

The standard library's subsequent numeric getaddrinfo is admitted only for that canonical pinned IP at port 443 and SOCK_STREAM. The original TLS hostname and Main URL/private-address policy are unchanged.
Connection admission is tightened from any port-443 destination to the same pinned IP at port 443 with AF_INET/AF_INET6, SOCK_STREAM, and no nonzero IPv6 flow/scope fields.
Each role begins with empty pinned/transport state. The transport finally clears URL, resolving flag, and IP; the outer finally restores both original Main aliases and clears active state.
The targeted diff does not add retries, widen credential/native file allowances, change route/prices/caps/payload contracts, or modify Main.
Safe event traces add exception types and numeric error metadata without dumping arbitrary exception text or credential data. Existing pre-transport UNKNOWN reservation and global stop remain intact.
The old08d UNKNOWN1 and 0.03 hold are explicitly preserved; successor 0.12 plus prior hold is reported as 0.15. This does not prove the old request incurred zero billing.
limitations: This is a targeted static diff assessment against the previously reviewed08d design, not an independently verified full successor source/manifest receipt.
Control counts, all161 Main pin equality, unchanged teacher bodies/config, and actual execution observations are producer/Root reports, not independently replayed here.
The runner uses one global active state in a sequential synchronous transport workflow; the targeted diff does not add concurrency or certify thread isolation.
A static PASS does not prove network success, provider submission/billing, raw scientific quality, native workflow completion, or human Gold. The actual08e source review is separately reported.
